19.text: Non Ranged Weapons deal +1d4 thunder damage permanently.

41.text: Cannot benefit from short rests. Only long rests restore resources.

55.stackCalc: Social bonus: +{count*2}, Damage per violation: {count} force

62.text: Cannot benefit from the Help action, given or received.

74.text: Gain +3 to one ability score (max 20). Permanent -1 to two other ability scores.

99.text: Once per session, automatically succeed on any save, attack, or check of your choice.

2.text: Ability: An elder bronze dragon appears and stays by your side for 2 sessions and will help you. It is a drug addict and will help you for some alcohol. It is not very smart and will often misunderstand situations, but it is very strong and will fight for you if you ask it to.

3.text: PC permanently loses 2 from their highest ability score.
3.stackRule: Nothing happens when rolled again in the same session by the same person.
